features.name: normalized_peak_intensity
features.description: Ratio of the primary spectral peak around 553nm to the blue region around 477nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-invariant measure of the primary spectral peak relative to the blue region, improving distance calculations by reducing the impact of absolute brightness.

features.name: spectral_slope_550_600
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the local derivative of the spectrum, allowing the KNN model to group samples with similar spectral shapes regardless of baseline shifts.

features.name: low_freq_high_freq_ratio
features.description: Ratio of visible light intensity to the near-infrared tail intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the visible light intensity against the near-infrared tail, creating a robust similarity score for neighborhood geometry.

features.name: mid_spectrum_curvature
features.description: Measures the convexity of the spectrum around the 553nm peak relative to its surrounding bands.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the convexity of the spectrum around the 550nm peak, providing a shape-based feature that enhances cluster separation in distance-based models.

features.name: overall_brightness_proxy
features.description: Average intensity across three representative bands spanning the visible spectrum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates intensity across multiple bands to serve as a stable prototype-distance feature, helping to stratify the neighborhood space.

features.name: normalized_band_difference_index
features.description: Normalized difference between the 553nm peak and the 696nm region.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a bounded [-1, 1] similarity score that is highly robust to multiplicative scaling effects, ideal for KNN distance metrics.

features.name: blue_green_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the 457nm band to the 517nm band.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights relative absorption differences in the shorter wavelengths, improving the local geometry of the feature space.

features.name: red_edge_proxy
features.description: Difference between the 676nm and 696nm bands, capturing the steepness of the spectral drop-off.
features.expected_model_benefit: Quantifies the steepness of the spectral drop-off in the red region, acting as a strong discriminator for distance-based clustering.

features.name: is_high_intensity_spectrum
features.description: Boolean indicator (0 or 1) if the overall spectrum intensity is unusually high compared to the dataset average.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a cluster indicator for unusually bright samples, preventing them from disproportionately skewing the distances of typical samples.

features.name: spectral_shape_cluster
features.description: Categorical integer (0 to 5) assigning the spectrum to one of several unsupervised prototype shapes (e.g., flat, peaked, skewed).
features.expected_model_benefit: Assigns samples to unsupervised prototype shapes, allowing the KNN to compute distances within more homogeneous sub-manifolds.

features.name: noise_level_estimate
features.description: Estimated high-frequency variance in the near-infrared region (bands > 800nm).
features.expected_model_benefit: Estimates high-frequency variance, which can be used to down-weight noisy neighbors or group samples with similar signal-to-noise ratios.

features.name: baseline_shift_indicator
features.description: Continuous score indicating the presence and magnitude of a baseline shift in typically dark regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies non-zero baselines in the near-infrared region, helping the model distinguish between true spectral features and sensor artifacts.
